drawingTraining.description: Question that asks users to count the number of bars that have a value greater than 1.
drawingTraining.instruction:
To the right, there is a drawing interface with a few options. 

 At the top of the canvas, you can change between a pencil and an eraser, change the size of your pencil, and change the color of your pencil. Below the options is a blank canvas for you to draw on. 

 Feel free to practice using the drawing interface now, and when you feel comfortable, click the next button to begin the drawing tasks.

response.prompt: Are you ready to begin?

drawingNetwork.description: Question that asks users to count the number of bars that have a value greater than 1.
drawingNetwork.instruction: Below is a list of authors, how many papers each author has published, and how many papers author pairs have published together. ![demo](data-literacy/assets/drawingTasks/networkTask.png) Sketch a visualization that you believe best represents this data. While doing so, please speak out loud to explain your thought process or any challenges you face. We suggest spending no more than 7 minutes on this task.
